articles.description: New Seattle Mariners manager Jason Kanzler spent five seasons with the Houston Astros, but he refused to name them in his press conference. Then, the team's GM and multiple reporters followed suit.
articles.title: Houston who? Jason Kanzler, Mariners, reporters avoid naming Astros in manager's press conference
